items.title: Watch: How Lula turned it around to beat former president's son
items.summary: Brazil's left-wing President has been elected for a fourth term after narrowly beating right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro in a knife-edge vote.

items.title: Storm Boelo leaves 90,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning
items.summary: Around 90,000 properties are without power after Scotland and north England is battered by strong winds.

items.title: Healey to shield low-income pensioners from income tax in the Budget
items.summary: Changes are needed to prevent the full, flat-rate state pension becoming liable for income tax after it rises in April.

items.title: Consultant doctors in England to strike next month
items.summary: Senior doctors to stage 48-hour walkout, beginning on 25 November, in dispute over pay and pensions.

items.title: Daughter wins £127k claim for caring for mum at home
items.summary: Bern Rogers says the row with her siblings since her elderly mother died was "harrowing and deeply sad".

items.title: Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement
items.summary: The populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his party has lost the vote billed as a referendum on the country's future.

items.title: Knighting Sinfield 'easiest decision anyone's had to make,' says Prince William
items.summary: The rugby league star is "gold dust" and "should have been Sir Kevin years ago," says the Prince of Wales.

items.title: Funding set to double for plan to get rough sleepers off streets by Christmas
items.summary: Burnham made ending rough sleeping his first pledge when entering Downing Street in July.
